training_config.precision: FP32 parameters, CUDA BF16 autocast, TF32 disabled; FP32 CPU fallback
training_config.loss: Answer token plus EOS, shifted causal CE, other targets ignored; same two supervised tokens/example in both encodings.
training_config.length_schedule: Uniform random permutations of all 21 lengths, repeat then truncate to20k; final length counts differ by at most1.
training_config.batch_schedule: 64 distinct anchors sampled per update from that length; saved batch_indices.npy shared by all32 models of a unit.
training_config.endpoint: Fixed final20k update checkpoint; no best-checkpoint or early-stopping selection.
training_config.execution: Single GPU, serial jobs; no concurrent step0 creation. Resume only when protocol/data/start hashes agree.

historical_index.policy: Reuse SHA-verified historical index, append all prior development input orbits; no historical inputs admitted.

data_audit.independent_world_policy: Independent seeded sampling conditional on the fixed historical exclusion universe. Different worlds may overlap; no cross-world model pairs are primary endpoints.

new_task_rng_policy: For each newly introduced task, bind the existing actual saved descents start RNG of the same architecture; paired encodings share that exact state. No old same-task RNG exists. All new tasks within an architecture share this stream (coupled). Original four tasks retain their original task-specific streams.
